Tiêu đề đề bài: Part 2 - Situation 1: Choosing a Science Book as a Gift
Nội dung chi tiết: Situation: You want to buy a science book as a gift for your 12-year-old cousin who has a keen interest in science. There are three types of science books to choose from: an illustrated encyclopedia about astronomy and space exploration, a handbook on wildlife and animal biology, or an interactive science experiment guide with practical DIY projects. Which book would you choose and why?

Nội dung chi tiết:
Topic: Effective ways to inspire students and young people to develop a passion for science
Suggestions:
- Organizing hands-on science experiments and interactive workshops in schools
- Providing engaging science books, documentaries, and digital media
- Arranging educational field trips to science museums and research centers
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. Why are fewer young students in some countries choosing science and engineering majors nowadays?
2. How can mass media and movies contribute to popularizing science among the general public?
3. Do you think governments should invest more funding in scientific research and space exploration?
